Let me look at the hmtx subset function more carefully. In the `subset` function:

```c
unsigned int num_advances = gids.len;
unsigned int last_advance = _mtx.get_advance (gids[num_advances - 1]);
```

If `gids.len == 0`, then `gids[num_advances - 1]` = `gids[-1]` which is out of bounds. But `gids` always contains at least glyph 0 (the notdef glyph is always added). So `gids.len >= 1`.

Let me look at the `_mtx.get_advance` function. When `glyph >= num_metrics`, it returns 0 or default_advance. When `glyph < num_metrics`, it returns `table->longMetric[MIN(glyph, num_advances-1)].advance`.

Hmm, this looks fine.
